notes.title: Patch notes 1.11
notes.content:
- Korean language is now supported.
- Fixed a bug in which the 10 yen game could be checked when being attacked by special enemies.
- The distance at which the sound of a door opening and closing is noticed by the target has been shortened.
- Shortened the time from when a target is detected to when its tracking accuracy begins to drop.
- Increased the maximum amount of error in enemy tracking accuracy.
- Adjusted the distance from which enemy footsteps and voices can be heard.
- Other minor adjustments have been made to enemy AI.

Special Thanks
Korean translation by DAEHYEOK
